messages:
Maya: LAN night idea: couch co-op Smash-ish tournament? Saturday 6pm in the rec room. Who's down?
Owen: I can do Saturday. Bringing my Switch + dock. Also have a 4-player adapter.
Priya: Ooh I vote for melee-style bracket (teams of 2). Would be fun to do random character swaps every round.
Marco: Im down but only as a spectator unless someone loans me a controller. Mine's in storage.
Maya: @Marco DM me, I have a spare Pro Controller.
snackbot: Snack rota: Maya (chips), Owen (salsa), Priya (veggies), Marco (cookies).
Owen: Also reminder: patch day for Smash on Saturday morning might mean updates. Bring local copies or allow time to update.
Priya: We can do casual warmup first. No rank pressure.
Maya: If we get a crowd, we can stream a tiny window to the break room TV (no audio) for folks to watch.
Marco: Is there a prize? Im terrible but will wear a silly hat if I lose.
Maya: Prize: 1 month of free coffee from the pod machine coupon.
Owen: Deal. Also I can bring ethernet cable for tournament station to avoid lag.
Priya: Perfect. See you Saturday! :joystick:
Maya: FYI, booking rec room now. If it disappears that's my bad, will rebook.
